'''Ghoss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he managed a small vendor stand, selling various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].<ref name="TOR" />
